craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the all-containing book-tree. Device: semicolon→comma (body stated softly), dash kept whole line 1 (hail held). Rejected: 'scripture' for 'shruti and lore' — kept the pair (heard + handed down); splitting the homage — killed: one bow, unbroken. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To the body built of thousand-boughed shruti and lore, hail —
to Śambhu, the wishing-tree of endless yield.
